prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares a GHZ state across qubits 0, 1, and 4 only: (|00000> + |10011>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase (qubits 2 and 3 remain |0>). This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i is only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1). Qubits 0 and 1 are adjacent on this line, but qubit 4 is far from both, so some routing overhead is expected — any correct implementation is accepted, the choice of internal two-qubit gate topology is yours.
